title: The Oracle's Overload
narrative_script: Anomaly Log 007. The Subject is the Oracle of Delphi, currently suffering catastrophic sensory overdose from processing five group chats and a corporate messaging app simultaneously. biometric data indicates severe [neuro-overload].
They survived the vapors of the sacred spring, but their nervous system is being [hijacked] by a barrage of glowing rectangles, while neuro-plasticity deteriorates.
Ancient biology is entirely incompatible with [weaponized] Silicon Valley code. The Subject is performing unpaid data entry for an [algorithm].
Willpower cannot defeat a supercomputer. A structural [override] is required for containment.
To quarantine the code and restore historical dopamine baselines, the Extraction [Protocol] is in the bio.
